# MyApp Project Instructions
Welcome to the MyApp project! This document provides important context and coding guidelines to ensure consistency and quality across all contributions.

Always try to improvise what we already have. Don't lose any previous functionality while improvising.

When I give a prompt, first try to understand the context, brainstorm possible solutions, then ask me clarification questions if any, then when we finalize on a solution, after then tell what approach will you follow or how will you solve, then finally start coding.
